translations.web: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?
translations.bsb: Does it please You to oppress me, to reject the work of Your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
translations.kjv: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
translations.asv: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
